The initial live cells in the 100x100 grid are all isolated, meaning none of them have any neighbors within their 3x3 Moore neighborhood. According to the rules of Conway's Game of Life, any live cell with fewer than two live neighbors dies; therefore, all live cells will die in the first step, resulting in a grid of all zeros that remains unchanged for the subsequent 9 steps.
